English:
FactChecker Pro is your personal fact-checking assistant that works alongside your browser to help you identify misinformation, verify claims, and research the credibility of sources in real time.

Whether you are reading news articles, scrolling through social media, or researching a topic online, FactChecker Pro gives you the tools to think critically about what you see.

Get an instant credibility score on any headline or claim using multiple AI engines including Google Fact Check Tools, Claude AI, and Gemini AI. See your browsing activity scored in real time and get notified when you land on a low-credibility site. Research claims across Twitter/X, Reddit, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and Substack from one unified Social Intelligence dashboard.

Build your personal Transparency Score by submitting and verifying claims. Earn points, unlock badges, and rise on the community leaderboard. Join thousands of fact-checkers working together to fight misinformation.

The desktop app works seamlessly with the FactChecker Pro browser extension, giving you a full-screen dashboard, system tray notifications, and persistent login across sessions.

Free tier includes 5 AI analyses per day with full community access. Premium plans available for heavier use.
